sql_generada: SELECT c.Name,c.NPN__c,o.Carrier,o.State,o.Line_Of_Business,s.StageName,s.Sub_stage,op.Internal_Notes__c,COUNT(Distinct p.Id) as Opp_Open FROM `claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.vw_opportunity` p LEFT JOIN `claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.dim_opp_stage` s ON s.key_stage = p.key_stage LEFT JOIN `claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.dim_cslb` o ON o.Id = p.CarrierStateLineOfBusiness_c LEFT JOIN `claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_claro.contact` c ON c.Id = p.Contact__c LEFT JOIN `claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.dim_account_2` a ON a.Id = c.AccountId LEFT JOIN `claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_claro.account_executives` ae on c.AE__c = ae.Id LEFT JOIN `claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_claro.opportunity` op ON op.Id = p.Id WHERE a.Name_Agencies != 'Agency Test' AND a.Name_Agencies IS NOT NULL AND s.StageName IN ('Blackout','Carrier Confirmation','Carrier link to be sent','In Progress - Action Needed','Missing Agent Information','Missing Certification','On hold','Pending Release','Started Contracting') AND a.Name_Agencies = 'Alliant Insurance Group' GROUP BY c.Name,c.NPN__c,o.Carrier,o.State,o.Line_Of_Business,s.StageName,s.Sub_stage,op.Internal_Notes__c
